review.inference: The process was terminated while running the full matrix. Exit 137 and the absence of a completed atomic report are consistent with an OOM or external SIGKILL. The likely trigger is an output-heavy correctness row whose complete stdout is retained by the benchmark harness, but the operating system did not provide a conclusive cause record.
review.scope: This is harness behavior, not a measured jq or yq result. Successful low-output large rows are archived separately.
review.follow_up: Before the release-scale full matrix, correctness capture must spool or hash bounded output instead of retaining multi-gigabyte result streams in memory.
